headline: iShares Global Healthcare ETF vs State Street SPDR Biotech ETF. Which Healthcare-Focused Fund Will Bring You Profits in 2026 and Beyond?
summary: XBI surged 80% in one year but endured a 54% drawdown, while IXJ delivered steadier gains with half volatility and a 1.4% dividend.
